RICHTECH ROBOTICS INC. is listed as a public company headquartered in Las Vegas, Nevada, with the ticker RR and CIK 0001963685. Its recorded website is rolls-royce.com, and the text drawn from that site describes Rolls-Royce, which says it develops and delivers complex power and propulsion solutions for safety-critical applications in the air, at sea and on land, and describes itself as having been at the forefront of innovation for more than 100 years. The company name and the site content do not match.

The site text reports several investments and partnerships. It states that Rolls-Royce invests £300 million in UK manufacturing and engineering facilities to drive aerospace and defence growth, and that Rolls-Royce completed a $1 Billion investment in Indiana. It also describes a strategic intent between Reliance Industries and Rolls-Royce to develop India's indigenous combat engine for the Advanced Medium Combat Aircraft (AMCA) programme, and cooperation between Rolls-Royce, the United Kingdom National Nuclear Laboratory and the Japan Atomic Energy Agency on advanced nuclear technologies.

The available facts list no AI products, no lawsuits and no MCP servers for the company. Its recorded law exposure is in Nevada, with a count of zero.
